regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing rotation (22 of 49 themes eligible, one-narrative flag false) with AI Infrastructure still ranked #1 but at low durability (breadth 0.125, score 1.56) and US Energy Complex #2 with much healthier breadth (0.636). The only validated detector edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control; momentum rank is an attention lens, and my dir_accuracy of 0.46 is below coin-flip, so I default to low conviction and lean on trend-health/breadth rather than rank.
emerging_watch: US Energy Complex is the only confirmed challenger to AI Infrastructure (margin 0.185, narrowing breadth 0.45). I am watching whether Energy's breadth (0.636) holds above 0.5 while AI Infrastructure's breadth (0.125) fails to recover — a confirmed leadership handoff would show Energy's score overtaking AI Infra with breadth still healthy; if AI Infra breadth rebounds toward 0.3 first, the watch retires.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex is eligible with the strongest breadth in the top ranks (0.636) and durability_bar 0.62, suggesting the theme's leadership is distributed across many names rather than carried by one or two — a healthier trend texture than the headline AI Infrastructure theme. The absolute-trend gate is satisfied, which is the one validated leg. I lean toward preferring this over the crowded #3 Cybersecurity theme as a way to express trend-following without paying for a crowding flag.
evidence: durability_bar 0.62 with breadth 0.636 (highest among top-ranked themes)
absolute-trend gate validated as risk-control leg
theses.dissent: Energy leadership may be a stalling commodity/narrative artifact; breadth can stay high while returns stagnate, and the detector has no validated forward edge on relative momentum.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks #3 with strong durability_bar (0.75) and a clean trend tag, but it is flagged crowded=true (crowding_z 1.61). Crowding is a size-down caution, not a short; since I cannot size, expressing this as an avoid lean is the most honest readable stance — declining to chase a trend whose crowding is elevated despite its otherwise healthy durability.
theses.dissent: Crowding flags have no validated forward edge and do not imply underperformance; a crowded up-trend can persist for long stretches.

falsifier.text: CIBR outperforms SPY by 5% over the next 30 trading days while remaining above its trend gate

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: This theme is eligible and has the highest durability_bar in the entire set (0.81) with excellent breadth (0.778), yet it is deep in the lower ranks (score -0.08, rank 28) and crowded=true. That combination — strong internal trend cohesion but weak relative leadership plus a crowding flag — makes it a poor place to add exposure; I avoid it rather than trust the durability alone.
theses.dissent: Internally it is the most durable trend in the table; defensive healthcare can lead late-cycle and its low rank may simply reflect how momentum rank works, not weakness.

falsifier.text: XLV (healthcare proxy) outperforms SPY by 5% over the next 30 trading days
